access_notes_i18n.zh-TW: 推薦時段採官方服務時間 08:00–17:00。園區全年開放；遊客中心除夕及每週一休館，寒暑假與國定假日例外。步道與自行車道遇落葉、潮濕或青苔可能濕滑。
access_notes_i18n.en: Recommendations use the official 08:00–17:00 service window. The park is open year-round; the visitor center closes on Lunar New Year's Eve and Mondays, except school vacations and national holidays. Paths may be slippery when wet or covered by leaves or moss.
